# Haider Akbar

> Haider Akbar (Muhammad Haider Akbar) is an AI Automation Engineer specializing in workflow automation, LLM integrations and agentic systems. He builds intelligent, scalable products that replace repetitive decision-making at scale, from MVPs for early-stage products to system integrations that unify platforms into seamless automated workflows.

Technologies he works with most: Python, n8n, Scrapling, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, FastAPI, TypeScript, AWS.

## Experience

- **AI Automation Engineer — Nysonian Inc.** (Islamabad, Pakistan; May 2026 to present): Built a brand protection platform that hunts counterfeit listings and files DMCA takedowns, protecting $500K+ in client revenue by taking down over 300 infringers. Ships brand reputation automations on n8n, from Trustpilot digests to live Reddit alerts.
- **Lead AI Automation Engineer — FRACK Technologies** (Islamabad, Pakistan; July 2025 to present): Built a client acquisition pipeline sourcing and qualifying leads, and delivers custom workflow automations from scoping to deployment.
- **Software Developer — Epistemy** (London, UK, remote; September to October 2025): Built an ed-tech platform cutting teacher review time by 58% via full workflow automation, with a cross-session Memory agent, a 9-agent LangGraph pipeline delivering the post-session suite in 2 minutes and a Critic agent cutting LLM API costs by 39%.
- **AI Engineer — DMLytics** (Islamabad, Pakistan; February to July 2025): Built a drone mapping platform cutting flight planning time by 57%, accelerating 300GB+ imagery preprocessing by 61% on GCP and enabling crop analytics on 500+ acres.

## Featured Projects

- **DeFaux**: An automated brand protection platform that hunts counterfeit product listings across the open web and files DMCA takedowns, verifying infringements with multi-signal image matching before reporting through the right enforcement channel.
- **JobSwipe** (https://www.jobswipe.works): An AI career platform where candidates swipe through live listings matched to their resume. A four-agent LangGraph system surfaces skill gaps and quizzes, and a right swipe produces a RAG-tailored resume, a cover letter and an auto-submitted application.
- **JobScout** (https://www.jobswipe.cloud): A fully unattended job board scraper keeping a live index of fresh listings in production, sweeping LinkedIn and Indeed across 60 curated roles with stealth browsers and delivering deduplicated, enriched data 8 times a day.
